content:
Forget champagne. Texas Senator-elect James Talarico and Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa celebrated their projected 2026 midterm election victories in quintessentially Texan fashion early Wednesday morning with a trip to Whataburger.

Talarico shared a photo of the pair raising their Texas-sized cups in a celebratory toast at the fast-food chain.

“First stop post-win: Whataburger,” he captioned the image.

Hinojosa also shared a video of the late-night celebration on X.

“We did it,” she wrote, tagging Talarico.

Talarico was projected to defeat GOP rival Ken Paxton in the Senate race, while Hinojosa was projected to oust three-term GOP Gov. Greg Abbott to become the state’s first Democratic governor in decades.
